description:
Listened to Maestra Miel: Slow English Podcast: Learn English at Home (Slow English).
let’s learn some house essentials🛋️This is calm, slow, and natural English, so you can relax and just listen and learn :))In this Slow English video, we talk about things I’ve bought for my home so far — like my couch, plants, kitchen items, blankets...What’s the most important thing in your home?For me, it’s the couch. It makes the place feel like home!If you enjoyed this video, like it so I can make more like this.And subscribe to learn English in a fun, real-life way. Hosted on Acast.
